Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, November 16 · NFL Week 10 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 3:11 PM ET

Derrick Henry has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chargers at Ravens DraftKings Showdown: 15.8 points at $10,000 FLEX, 23.6 at captain for $15,000. Across 10,000 simulations Henry holds 70% of the winning-lineup credit. Jacoby Brissett holds the most, at 74%. The case against Henry is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 5.0 points at a $10,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 38.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 23.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Henry at captain. Zay Flowers is the next captain in line, at 21.9%. The model gives him 6.3 targets on 19.8 routes.

Baltimore is a 4.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 21.5 for the Ravens and 17 for the Chargers. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Henry and Flowers, the next projections are Jacoby Brissett (15.0, $9,200), Justin Herbert (14.7, $9,000) and Tre' Harris (9.6, $6,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 3:11 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Derrick Henry, BAL RB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Derrick Henry holds 23.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 15.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 19.6 carries and 1.2 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Henry averaged 15.8 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 33.3. He holds 70% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 23.3% as the captain and 46.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Zay Flowers, BAL WR ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Zay Flowers holds 21.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 14.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 6.3 targets on 19.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Flowers averaged 15.2 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 40.3. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.9% as the captain and 35.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Justin Herbert, LAC QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Justin Herbert holds 16.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $13,500 and the 14.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.1 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Herbert averaged 14.7 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 29.9. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.0% as the captain and 55.7% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Chargers vs Ravens

Jacoby Brissett, BAL QB ($9,200 FLEX / $13,800 CPT)

Jacoby Brissett carries the 2nd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.0 DraftKings points for a $9,200 FLEX salary ($13,800 at captain). The model includes 3.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Brissett averaged 15.2 points with a simulated floor of 5.1 and a ceiling of 30.5. He holds 74% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.1% as the captain and 58.8% in a FLEX spot.

Tre' Harris, LAC WR ($6,800 FLEX / $10,200 CPT)

Tre' Harris carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.6 DraftKings points for a $6,800 FLEX salary ($10,200 at captain). The model gives him 5.4 targets on 23.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Harris averaged 9.5 points with a simulated floor of 2.5 and a ceiling of 21.5. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.7% as the captain and 34.9% in a FLEX spot.

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

Omarion Hampton carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 8.4 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 11.7 carries and 2.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Hampton averaged 8.5 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 16.2. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.1% as the captain and 28.7% in a FLEX spot.

Quentin Johnston, LAC WR ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Quentin Johnston carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 7.6 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 5.5 targets on 29.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Johnston averaged 7.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.4 and a ceiling of 20.0. He holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.1% as the captain and 23.5% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Ravens, BAL DST ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Ravens projects for 7.6 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.90 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Ravens averaged 7.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.7. It holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.7% as the captain and 37.7% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Chargers, LAC DST ($3,400 FLEX / $5,100 CPT)

Chargers projects for 5.7 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.68 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Chargers averaged 5.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.8. It holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.7% as the captain and 19.9% in a FLEX spot.

Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Derrick Henry holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 23.3%, ahead of Zay Flowers (21.9%) and Justin Herbert (16.0%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Chargers vs Ravens?

Build around Zay Flowers at captain with Derrick Henry, Jacoby Brissett and Tre' Harris at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (24 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,400 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

Derrick Henry leads the SPAGS model at 15.8 DraftKings points for $10,000 at FLEX, or 23.6 points at captain for $15,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Chargers vs Ravens Showdown?

Zay Flowers is the most expensive player at $10,400 FLEX and $15,600 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Chargers vs Ravens DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Ravens (7.6 points at $4,000), Chargers (5.7 points at $3,400) and Rashod Bateman (6.0 points at $3,800).

What is the Chargers vs Ravens spread and total?

The Ravens are a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 38.5, with implied team totals of 21.5 for the Ravens and 17 for the Chargers.
